analysis.title: GS Duttenhoefer - Charts at Goldman Sachs 5 Oct 2026
key_insights: More than $1.5trn has flowed into US-listed ETFs in 2026, already above last year's record annual total after three quarters. GS expects US ETF flows to pass $2trn for the year.
Average daily ETF inflows exceed $8bn per session as of September 29, 2026.
Market breadth has recently plunged. GS measures it as the gap between the aggregate index's and the median stock's distance from 52-week highs.
The share of stocks with a negative beta has increased, similar to the Tech Bubble period.
Bottom-up consensus has S&P 500 Q3 2026 EPS growth at 27% y/y, while the median S&P 500 stock is expected to grow EPS 9%. The gap between the two points to a narrow group of earnings contributors.
The S&P 500 forward P/E has declined to its 10-year average.
Hyperscalers have reported large and growing cloud revenue backlogs. Consensus shows hyperscaler capex growth above 100% y/y in Q3, and FCF yield has been weighed down by capex spending.
Global data center GPU power demand is projected to rise from 13,510MW in 2025 to 150,081MW in 2030, a CAGR of +62%.
AI-driven demand for cybersecurity exposure has the ETF complex on track for one of its best months of inflows in GS's dataset (+$950m).
French bond spreads have widened sharply.
Large-cap dominance is much higher in the US than in Europe, so the US market is more concentrated. The top 10 US companies dominate the world equity market.
European banks have outperformed the Magnificent 7 since 2022.
Interest expense increases from higher borrowing costs have been manageable.
Longer-term structural charts: seniors are set to dominate developed-market demographics, and robot shipment forecasts quadruple (GS research).
earnings_insights: Q3 2026 S&P 500 EPS growth: bottom-up consensus estimate of 27% y/y (FactSet, forecast, not yet reported).
Q3 2026 median S&P 500 stock: consensus estimate of 9% EPS growth (forecast, not yet reported).

Narrowing breadth, with the index far closer to highs than the median stock.
Hyperscaler capex is weighing on free cash flow yield.
French bond spreads have widened sharply.
